//: Vibecoding preset for full-stack web apps (the Bun/Hono/Prisma/React/Astro/Expo 'vibe' template). Copy to a project root as .mcp.json. context7 + playwright need no key; github + supabase need tokens set as env vars. Stays within the 3-5 active-server rule.

context7.//: Current, version-specific library docs. No key.

github.//: [key] Official remote GitHub MCP. Needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

supabase.//: [key] Supabase DB/config (read-only by default). Needs SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
